landing.cta.text: Every feature included, no card required. Bring your own AI keys, or wait for Pro with Termoak AI credit included.
landing.cta.title: Free forever
landing.feature.ai.text: Ask the AI to investigate a failure or prepare a deployment. It works on its own and asks for permission before running anything sensitive.
landing.feature.ai.title: Background AI, with approvals
landing.feature.apps.text: Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android. Fast, native and with your data always up to date.
landing.feature.apps.title: Native apps everywhere
landing.feature.autocomplete.text: Command suggestions as you type and automatic detection of each host's system: Debian, Alpine, RHEL, macOS…
landing.feature.autocomplete.title: Autocomplete and system detection
landing.feature.persistent.text: Your terminals live on the server, not on your laptop. Close the lid, switch to your phone or lose coverage: when you come back everything is still there, with its history and its processes.
landing.feature.persistent.title: Persistent sessions on the server
landing.feature.sharing.text: Invite a person, your whole team or create a link. You decide whether they can only watch or also type, and when the access expires.
landing.feature.sharing.title: Share with your team or with a link
landing.feature.source.text: The apps and the server are open source under the AGPL-3.0 license: read and audit the code, install the server on your own infrastructure and point the apps at it.
landing.feature.source.title: Open source, self-hostable
landing.feature.two_factor.text: Protect your account with an authenticator app and single-use recovery codes.
landing.feature.two_factor.title: Two-step verification
landing.feature.vault.text: Hosts, keys, identities and snippets encrypted and synced across all your devices. Secrets never travel in plain text.
landing.feature.vault.title: Encrypted, synced vault
landing.features.lead: Termoak combines a native client with its own server: your sessions, your data and your team, always in sync.
landing.features.title: Everything you expect from a modern SSH client. And more.
landing.hero.lead: Termoak is an SSH client that keeps your terminals open on the server. Switch devices, lose the Wi-Fi or shut down your computer and pick them up right where you left off. Share them with your team, let the AI work in the background and keep your secrets in an encrypted vault.

landing.hero.title: Close your laptop.

pricing.faq.ai_keys.a: Add your own API keys (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) in your account and Termoak uses them for the background AI. You pay your provider directly for what you use.
pricing.faq.ai_keys.q: How does AI work on the Free plan?
pricing.faq.data.a: On the Termoak server you connect to. Secrets (passwords and keys) are stored encrypted and only revealed to your devices.
pricing.faq.free.a: Yes. The Free plan includes every feature, with no card and no time limit. It is not a trial.
pricing.faq.pro.a: Everything in Free plus priority support and Termoak AI credit: AI included, with no API keys to configure. It is not available yet; we will announce it when it is.
pricing.faq.self_host.a: Yes. The Termoak server can be installed on your own infrastructure; the apps connect to the address you choose.
